description: For every old function symbol \(f\), including a constant, the specified quotient satisfies \(f^{Q_N}(q\circ\bar a)=q(f^N(\bar a))\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.quotient_function.{u, v, z} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {N : Type z}
  [(Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Extended L).Structure N]
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.Axioms L N) {n : ℕ} (f : L.Functions n) (a : Fin n → N) :
  FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap f (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h ∘ a) =
    Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.EqualityAxioms.projection h (FirstOrder.Language.Structure.funMap f a)
